author: unknown
content:
Has anyone’s company switched them to using the “Instant” app for their tip money?
My job is switching to giving us our tips through this app/Visa card and I have a lot of concerns about it. 
I get that giving out cash every night to drivers has its issues, but I’m worried about being able to easily transfer my money from the card to my bank account (I’ve seen reviews where they said that they had to pay fees for the transfer and that the transfer has taken over a week in some cases) and I’m worried about the security of it all. 

How have your guys’ experiences been with it?
